stages.title: Initialize and observe process restart
stages.desired_change: Deploy atlas-api, scale1→2→1; save service/task/node/container IDs, restart a new server process.
stages.expected_observation: Services/node registration maps disappear after a fresh process; surviving Docker identity is separate.
stages.failure_injection: Terminate only recorded server PID; leave recorded service container for comparison, then stop agent and remove exact IDs.
telemetry: Docker inspect for recorded container IDs
stages.cleanup: Restore fresh disposable server/agent; do not reuse pre-restart API IDs as live truth.

stages.title: Deterministic placement and concurrent claims
stages.desired_change: Present500m CPU/128Mi node and service600m/256Mi requests; then attempt two assignments of one pending task.
stages.expected_observation: Pure planner rejects capacity; normal MemoryService placement can differ. Only one guarded assignment succeeds at a version.
stages.failure_injection: Inject identical resource intent into both paths, not a large physical machine; race stale writers in a package fixture.
telemetry: both assignment errors and final owner
stages.cleanup: Discard fake objects and throwaway schema; stop/delete only owned database container after later tests.

stages.title: Reconciliation and Docker drift ownership
stages.desired_change: Keep atlas-api identity; remove one exact recorded container to simulate drift; restart agent, then stop heartbeat.
stages.expected_observation: Reconciliation observes missing runtime identity; adoption should not duplicate the same task. Offline replacement is not physical fencing.
stages.failure_injection: Remove only the selected owned container; suspend only recorded agent PID, not host networking.
stages.cleanup: Resume/stop exact recorded agent; remove all and only run-owned containers. No broad orch.managed cleanup.

stages.title: Rollout, rollback and availability
stages.desired_change: Roll atlas-api to nginx1.28-alpine, then rollback while tracking immutable deployment versions.
stages.expected_observation: Old/new available counts control actions. A failed pull or unhealthy new task must be distinguished from rollback completion.
stages.failure_injection: Use a deliberately nonexistent image in a separate failing rollout; never replace a real user service.
stages.cleanup: Restore known image or delete atlas-api; remove exact residual task containers.

stages.title: Secrets, authorization and health trust
stages.desired_change: Apply atlas-api-unhealthy manifest in its lab namespace and attempt untrusted reports; trace encrypted secret storage separately.
stages.expected_observation: Missing path produces unhealthy observations; cross-origin redirect fixture must fail; plaintext delivery differs from stored ciphertext.
stages.failure_injection: Use localhost test HTTP handlers and disposable credentials; no external metadata endpoint probing.
stages.cleanup: Restore healthy Atlas manifest; stop owned local handler, delete disposable secret references and namespace when empty.

stages.title: Namespaces and atomic quota admission
stages.desired_change: Create same service name in isolated second namespace; bound intended replicas/resources and attempt exceeding mutation.
stages.expected_observation: Names are scoped; accepted desired intent affects accounting. This does not establish Docker CPU/memory enforcement.
stages.failure_injection: Race scale/create under a quota in fixture; keep primary and second service IDs distinct.
stages.cleanup: Delete namespace-specific service IDs first; delete only empty namespaces and restore lab quotas.

stages.title: GitOps drift, finite jobs and cron
contexts: default job command propagation plus package/FakeRuntime cron assertions; actual finite execution measured separately
stages.desired_change: Commit atlas-api manifest to dedicated local repo; modify first valid file and second invalid file; create atlas-count finite JobSpec.
stages.expected_observation: First file may change service before second fails. Agent copies the command into ContainerSpec; job exit reporting and identity/adoption still need an executed check.
stages.failure_injection: No remote Git push. Inject clock for cron rather than change system time; invalid second manifest exercises partial application.
telemetry: source LastError/LastRevision and actual service spec
stages.cleanup: Delete exact GitOps source before service; stop package fixture; remove owned temp repository after evidence copy.

stages.title: Backup, migration, load and recovery boundaries
stages.desired_change: Test DB migration subset/all migrations explicitly, two-session cancellation, bounded load; compare SQL backup with current memory state.
stages.expected_observation: Database restore recovers only persisted database content. Fresh default process remains new MemoryService; benchmark scope is not Docker cluster capacity.
stages.failure_injection: Cancel leadership owner session; bound workload/time; never stress user daemon or restore into real database.
telemetry: migration list and actual up/down results
stages.cleanup: Stop exact PIDs; remove exact owned DB/volume/containers; report leftovers explicitly and keep canonical logs.
